title: Step 70 CI Step57 Playwright runner compatibility (Ubuntu 24.04 pin)
description: Fix exact observed 2026-11-17 Step57 Prototype failure caused by Playwright 1.55.0 refusing Ubuntu 26.04 during ubuntu-latest migration. Pin only Step57 workflow runner to ubuntu-24.04, retain all test, security, quality and browser steps unchanged. No security-gate bypass; isolated from Step70-G business and owner-only governance PRs.

dependencies.item: GitHub Issue #401 Ubuntu 26.04 Playwright 1.55 CI failure

evidence.strict_negative_scope: Only 'runs-on: ubuntu-latest' becomes 'runs-on: ubuntu-24.04' in Step57 workflow; no Playwright or test version, steps, required gates, branch protection or permission changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: One-line runner pin from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-24.04 in only Step57 Prototype workflow; other workflow bytes and every browser/security/a11y/test step identical.
Full Step57 Prototype workflow including Chromium install, exhaustive browser/interactions/a11y audit and screenshots executes to PASS on actual GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04.
Canonical CI and Phase A execute successfully on the exact PR head; deterministic Review/Verification remain mandatory.
Scope and task catalog are exactly regenerated/validated; no runtime code, security or release policy modified.
Current MEDIUM risk and exact-artifact ACTIVE Scope Lock plus protected-main Merge Policy validation required; no direct main write or gate spoofing.

external_gate_evidence.rule: MEDIUM requires deterministic Review/Verification, ACTIVE exact-artifact Scope Lock, protected-main required CI; no waiver, suppression, skip or modified security gate.
